page.title: Practise interviews with AI
page.lead: Answer out loud like in a real interview, then get detailed feedback.

setup.title: Set up your interview
setup.cvHint: Optional, PDF or DOCX. Questions will follow your experience.
setup.jdHint: Optional: paste the job description (JD) of the role you are applying for.
setup.pickTrack: Please choose the role you want to practise for first.
setup.quotaRemaining: You have {{remaining}}/{{limit}} practice interviews left today
setup.jobFailed: This job could not be loaded. You can paste the job description in the box below instead.

permission.title: Get your microphone ready
permission.lead: The AI reads each question aloud and you answer with your microphone. Speech is turned into text for the AI to assess; the audio is not stored.
permission.micText: Agree so your voice can be turned into text
permission.serviceDown: Not ready. Use the switch to check again.
permission.micDenied: The browser has not allowed the microphone. Click the padlock icon in the address bar to allow it, or start and answer by typing.

question.answerPlaceholder: Type your answer, then press Send (Ctrl/⌘ + Enter)
question.note: Note: do not reload the page during the interview or you will lose the session.

chat.preparing: The AI is preparing your interview…
chat.listening: The AI is listening to your answer…
chat.emptyAnswer: You have not typed an answer yet.
chat.notCounted: This answer was not recorded, please answer again.
chat.notSent: This answer could not be sent.

rec.recording: Recording {{time}} • press the mic again to stop and send
rec.reading: The AI is reading the question…
rec.voiceUnavailable: Voice is not available right now. Read the question above and type your answer below.
rec.speakFailed: The question could not be played. Read it above, then press the mic to answer.
rec.noSpeech: No speech was heard. Check your microphone and record again, or type your answer.
rec.noSpeechCounted: We could not hear your answer clearly, so it was not counted. Please answer again.
rec.micOffTyping: The microphone is off, please type your answer below.
rec.serviceDownTyping: The voice service is having problems, please type your answer below.
rec.stopLabel: Stop recording and send your answer

meters.label: Microphone level and voice service status

stop.title: Do you want to stop the interview?
stop.text: It sounds like you want to finish. You can stop now and see feedback for the questions you answered.

end.title: End the interview?
end.textWithAnswers: The AI will summarise feedback for the questions you answered.
end.textNoAnswers: You have not answered any question, so there will be no feedback.

result.title: All done
result.lead: Thank you for taking part in the interview.
result.loading: The AI is putting your feedback together…
result.empty: You ended before answering any question, so there is no feedback. Press “New session” to try again.
result.done: Your interview lasted {{minutes}} min with {{answers}} answers. Detailed feedback is below.
result.reportFailed: The feedback could not be created.

report.partial: Part of the feedback could not be generated, so this result may be incomplete.

voiceSummary.title: How you came across when speaking
voiceSummary.none: You have not answered any question by voice.
voiceSummary.disclaimer: These figures are only to help you practise how you speak; they do not count towards your knowledge score.

agentNotes.title: What the AI noticed during the session

errors.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again to continue.
errors.quotaExceeded: You have used all your practice interviews for today. Come back tomorrow.
errors.voiceDown: The voice service is having problems. Try again, or press “Type instead of speaking”.

codes.session_not_found: The interview has expired on the server. Please start a new one.
codes.audio_too_long: That answer was too long. Please keep it shorter (under 3 minutes).
codes.invalid_audio: The recording could not be read. Please record again.
codes.unauthorized: Your session is not valid. Please reload the page.
codes.misconfigured: The system is not ready yet. Please try again later.
codes.cv_invalid_format: This CV could not be read. Please use a PDF or DOCX file (without a password).
codes.cv_too_large: The CV is too long or too large. Please try a file under 10 MB.
codes.cv_unreadable: No text could be read from the CV (it may be a scan). Please try a PDF or DOCX with real text.
codes.session_id_reused: This interview has already ended. Please start a new session.
codes.interview_helper_quota_exceeded: You have used today's voice and CV processing allowance. You can still answer by typing.
codes.upstream_misconfigured: The AI service is being reconfigured. Please try again in a few minutes.

errors.network: Connection lost. Check your network and try again.
errors.streamCut: The AI did not finish responding. Please try again.
errors.timeout: The AI took too long to respond. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.upstream: The AI service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.rejected: The request was not accepted. Please check your details and try again.
errors.busy: The system is busy. Please try again in a few minutes.

forbidden.title: This feature is for candidates
forbidden.text: AI interview practice is only available to candidate accounts. You can go back to the home page to continue.
